CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %PREFIX%_event_attendance_excuses ( eax_id integer unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, eax_tracker_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, eax_usr_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, eax_date_from date NOT NULL, eax_date_until date NULL, eax_created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, eax_revoked_at timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (eax_id), CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_eax_tracker FOREIGN KEY (eax_tracker_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_event_attendance_trackers (eat_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_eax_user FOREIGN KEY (eax_usr_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_idx_eax_tracker_user UNIQUE (eax_tracker_id, eax_usr_id, eax_id) )
